thread:
Mira Chen: uploaded a new mock for the on-prem setup wizard — focus on the "compact advanced network" pattern. link: https://figma.com/file/xyz

Ajay Patel: nice! quick thought: the collapsed advanced panel currently hides the egress probe status. users keep asking where the connectivity result went. we should surface a one-line status + timestamp when collapsed. :eyes:

Sam Rivera: agree. propose microcopy: `Advanced network settings — collapsed (showing probe status: Healthy · 2m ago)` with a small chevron to expand. keeps engineers confident without expanding.

Lin Gomez: accessibility nit: the collapsed region needs an ARIA label that includes the status, otherwise screen readers miss the probe outcome. maybe `aria-label="Advanced network settings; status: Healthy; last checked 2 minutes ago"`.

Mira Chen: good call, lin. also thinking about handoff to support: add a `Need help? Open support request` link that pre-populates the diagnostics bundle. avoids a full expand for most users.

Sam Rivera: +1. Implementation note: the diagnostics link should call `/support/tickets/new?bundle=probe&host=<host>` so we can attach the exact probe. i'll stub the endpoint.

Ajay Patel: UX tweak on copy: instead of `Advanced network settings` use `Advanced network options (for self-hosted infra)` — clearer for non-network folks. but longer; we can shorten in UI and use tooltip for the parenthetical.

Mira Chen: happy with parenthetical in tooltip. also want a microcopy state for `collapsed + issues`: `1 issue · See details` where `See details` expands to the probe summary. keeps the stepper small for most flows.

Lin Gomez: for keyboard users, ensure the collapsed header is focusable and pressing Enter toggles expand. focus should move into the first actionable item when expanded. add `aria-expanded` changes.

ops-bot: reminder — design review scheduled in #all-hands on 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC. uploaded figma file v3.

Sam Rivera: technical thought: showing last probe time means we need to surface fresher probes for collapsed panels without incurring full re-run cost. we can surface cached result + a `refresh` button on hover that triggers a cheap probe.

Ajay Patel: visual: use a muted pill for status (green/amber/red) and a condensed timestamp `· 2m ago`. we should avoid color-only cues; include icon + sr-only text.

Mira Chen: final ask for this pass: produce three copy variants for the collapsed header (short, explanatory w/ tooltip, issue state) and a short ARIA spec. i'll run a quick hallway test afterwards.

Lin Gomez: i'll draft the aria spec and keyboard behavior. Sam — can you wire the support link placeholder?

Sam Rivera: yes, i'll wire it and include a fallback toast if bundle creation fails.

Mira Chen: thanks everyone — pushing updated figma in 30m. :thumbsup:
